title: OpenAI 称 GPT-6 Astra 一周内从零设计出一款硬件设备,自研内部模型在 BenchCAD 2.0 上得 0.875
summary: OpenAI 的硬件团队用 GPT-6 Astra 从外壳设计、PCB 布局到固件全流程做出一台可对话的 Codex 设备,不到一周完成原型设计——这是本时段唯一同时动了模型、产品和硬件三条线的新闻。
summary_en: The note reports OpenAI’s claim that its hardware team used GPT-6 Astra to design a conversational Codex device end to end—from enclosure and PCB layout to firmware—completing a prototype in under a week. It says an internally developed model scored 0.875 on BenchCAD 2.0, presenting this as the period’s sole story spanning models, products, and hardware simultaneously.
body:
OpenAI 的硬件团队用 GPT-6 Astra 从外壳设计、PCB 布局到固件全流程做出一台可对话的 Codex 设备,不到一周完成原型设计——这是本时段唯一同时动了模型、产品和硬件三条线的新闻。
